references.text: The father-in-law wanted him to stay, and he agreed to live there—the same Hebrew expression (וַיּוֹאֶל) is used for agreeing to stay with someone.
Moses agreed (וַיּוֹאֶל) to live with the man Jethro, just as the Levite agreed to live with Micah.
Introduces the young man who was a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, now becoming like one of Micah's own sons.
The same young Levite who lived with Micah is later recognized by the Danites.
Jacob adopted Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons—a similar concept where someone is counted as one of your own children.
